method: Static trace of every distance-derived term reaching the opportunity or fission decision, recorded as physical quantity -> normalized value -> conceptual role -> coefficient -> consuming formula -> downstream result.
rule: §9 — a repeated term is NOT automatically defective; it may represent distinct costs. It is defective only when the SAME physical consequence is charged repeatedly under different names. Mediation must be proven by counterfactual before double-counting is declared.

terms.conceptualRole: DESTINATION PREFERENCE — which known place is the better destination
terms.downstreamResult: selects the single best-by-score candidate, which becomes bestKnownUnusedHabitatOpportunity

terms.physicalQuantity: NONE OF ITS OWN — it reads input.opportunity.travelCost, the value T1 already computed
terms.conceptualRole: SPLIT MOTIVATION — whether a subgroup has reason to leave at all
terms.consumingFormula: pressure = saturation*0.35 + perCapitaStress*0.25 + opportunityScore*0.25 + riskTolerance*0.1 + sharedSaturation*0.12 + boosts - attachment*0.2 - travelRiskPenalty*0.2
terms.verdict: SUSPECTED DUPLICATION — this consumes the SAME normalized number T1 already used to discount the destination, and applies it to a DIFFERENT conceptual stage (motivation, not preference). A band that discovers good distant country is penalised once in choosing it and again in wanting to split at all. NOT YET PROVEN: §9 requires counterfactual mediation (arm D2) before declaring double-counting.

terms.physicalQuantity: getGridDistance(currentTile, candidateTile) — recomputed independently of T1
terms.normalization: distancePenalty = clamp01(max(0, distance - 8) / 18)  — zero inside 8 tiles, saturates at 26
terms.conceptualRole: DESTINATION PREFERENCE, in a DIFFERENT subsystem and over a DIFFERENT candidate set
terms.coefficient: -0.34, relaxed by frontier-intent alignment and founder distance relax
terms.downstreamResult: selects the actual fission target tile
terms.verdict: DISTINCT FORMULA AND DISTINCT CANDIDATE SET — a different normalization (threshold 8, span 18 vs saturating at 12) applied by a different authority to a different question. This is a duplicated CONCEPT rather than a duplicated charge, and §9 explicitly permits distance to affect both feasibility and preference. Not classified as a defect.

terms.conceptualRole: NON-OVERLAP — penalises being too CLOSE, opposite in sign to T3
terms.verdict: LEGITIMATE and conceptually distinct — this is the separation motive, not a travel cost

terms.conceptualRole: the PARENT's own foraging accessibility inside its existing range
terms.verdict: UNRELATED to destination distance — shares a variable name only. Recorded so a later reader does not mistake it for a fourth destination penalty.

roleMatrix.candidateCollection: NO distance term (the <=8 proximity rule in contextCache.isKnownOpportunityRecord is a DOMAIN filter, not a scored penalty)
roleMatrix.candidateRanking: T1 (opportunity) and T3 (fission target) — two different subsystems, two different normalizations
roleMatrix.viability: NO distance term — consideredAsTarget tests expectedPerCapita, water and risk only
roleMatrix.splitMotivation: T2 (same term; colonization pressure IS the motivation signal)
roleMatrix.physicalMovementFeasibility: route construction only; no scored penalty

conclusion.reason: T2 has no physical quantity of its own; it re-consumes T1's normalized travelCost in a different conceptual stage. That is the pattern §9 describes as likely-invalid ('distance lowers destination score AND then lowers the underlying reason to split'). But §9 forbids declaring it without proving mediation.
conclusion.requiredProof: Arm D2 — neutralize distance in the colonization-pressure term ONLY, leaving T1 ranking and T3/T4 final selection intact, and measure whether selected opportunity, pressure, fission recommendation, actual fission and fission year move.
conclusion.notRun: D0-D5 counterfactual arms were NOT executed in this checkpoint. The duplication remains SUSPECTED, not proven, and no production change was made on the strength of it.
